items.title: Uber (UBER) Backs Travis Kalanick’s Atoms With $100 Million
items.summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has committed a $100 million investment to Atoms, the robotics and automation company founded by former CEO Travis Kalanick. The deal reconnects Uber with Kalanick after his high profile departure and links the ride hailing group to a new industrial AI and automation venture. items.title: Lucid Is Now Up 33% in a Month, Easily Beating Tesla and Rivian. What Will It Take to Get LCID Stock Back to $10?
items.summary: A Saudi prince just bought a $129 million stake in Lucid, sparking a 25% intraday surge that left Tesla and Rivian in the dust. But with a fraud lawsuit, a looming earnings report, and a bankruptcy clock ticking, the road to $10 runs through far more than a short squeeze.

items.title: Uber Eats is sued over priority delivery fees
items.summary: A proposed class action lawsuit argues that the company’s “direct to you” delivery option is misleading because couriers may make other stops along the way.

items.title: McDonald’s, Oracle, and Uber Are Near 52-Week Lows. Wall Street Says Buy Anyway.
